column1: # FINAL FANTASY VIII Remastered, BaseEngine, SDK 7.4.0. main is a small loader (3,712 instructions); the game is 14 NROs it loads with nn::ro. Rendering.nro and Platform.nro
# draw with OpenGL ES through EGL and compile their GLSL with GLSLC at run time (captured by booting the game on the Mac). subsdk2 is NVIDIA's OpenGL driver: never loaded, the GL layer
# answers the NROs' EGL / GL imports. Math.nro and Platform.nro need dm/tools/mod_layout.py in patch_nso.py (their data shared the code's 16 KB page)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk. main imports only from sdk; the NROs import from subsdk0 (GLSLC) and subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource
